cases.name: new work follows active runtime
cases.evidence: n8n, azure_native, and hybrid route selection are deterministic.

cases.name: queued work remains provider-bound
cases.evidence: Background and Skill jobs persist runtime_provider at enqueue and pass it unchanged to execution.

cases.name: detached Learning remains Azure-native
cases.evidence: Learning jobs persist azure_native and reject a conflicting provider without retry.

cases.name: pinned Azure work cannot fall back to n8n
cases.evidence: The adapter disables cross-provider fallback whenever runtimeProvider is pinned.

cases.name: unknown completion remains terminal
cases.evidence: Existing lease-expiry and attempt-fencing tests prevent redispatch or stale completion.

remaining_live_gate: After deployment, perform one controlled runtime switch for new synthetic no-write work while proving already queued, processing, unknown, and terminal job IDs retain their provider and are not replayed.
boundary: Synthetic no-write rehearsal. No production runtime flag or production data was changed.
